proof:
Context. This child is step 2(i), step 2(ii) and the absolute continuity mu << H^n used in step 8 of the proof of gwe_graph_tangential_estimate. It uses only the definitions RectifiableVarifold.weight and RectifiableVarifold.support and the structure fields carrier_subset, nullMeasurableSet_carrier and integrableOn_mult. No extra import is needed.

Notation. H := muHE[n] on R^{n+l}, M := V.carrier, theta := V.mult, rho(x) := ofReal(theta(x)), H|M := H.restrict M. By definition mu = V.weight = (H|M).withDensity rho, and spt V = V.support = U cap mu.support.

1. Absolute continuity. A measure with density is absolutely continuous with respect to its base measure, so mu << H|M (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous). A restriction is below the measure, H|M <= H (Measure.restrict_le_self), hence H|M << H (Measure.absolutelyContinuous_of_le). By transitivity, mu << H.
2. Proof of (iii). Let H(Z) = 0. By step 1, mu(Z) = 0. Absolute continuity of measures is a statement about all sets, so no measurability of Z is needed.
3. Proof of (i). Let K be compact with K contained in U.
 a. K is closed, since R^{n+l} is Hausdorff (IsCompact.isClosed). Hence K is Borel.
 b. Since K is measurable, withDensity_apply gives mu(K) = int^-_K rho d(H|M), the lower integral of rho against (H|M) restricted to K.
 c. Since K is measurable, Measure.restrict_restrict gives (H|M) restricted to K = H restricted to K cap M. So mu(K) = int^-_{K cap M} rho dH, and K cap M = M cap K.
 d. The field V.integrableOn_mult applied to K (compact, K contained in U) says theta is H-integrable on M cap K. In particular its finite-integral part gives int^-_{M cap K} ||theta||_e dH < infinity.
 e. For every x, rho(x) = ofReal(theta(x)) <= ofReal(|theta(x)|) = ||theta(x)||_e, because theta(x) <= |theta(x)|.
 f. By monotonicity of the lower integral, mu(K) <= int^-_{M cap K} ||theta||_e dH < infinity.
4. Proof of (ii). The complement of spt V = U cap mu.support is U^c cup (mu.support)^c (compl_inter). So it suffices to show that both pieces are mu-null (measure_union_null).
 a. mu((mu.support)^c) = 0 by Measure.measure_compl_support. Its hypothesis HereditarilyLindelofSpace holds because R^{n+l} is second countable.
 b. mu(U^c) = 0. By step 1 it suffices that (H|M)(U^c) = 0. M is H-null-measurable (V.nullMeasurableSet_carrier), so Measure.restrict_apply₀' gives (H|M)(U^c) = H(U^c cap M). Since M is contained in U (V.carrier_subset), U^c cap M is empty, and H of the empty set is 0.
 c. Hence mu((spt V)^c) = 0. QED
key_steps: mu = (H^n|M).withDensity(ofReal theta) << H^n|M << H^n (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous, absolutelyContinuous_of_le restrict_le_self); this is (iii).
(i): K compact => closed => Borel; mu(K) = int^-_{M cap K} ofReal(theta) dH^n (withDensity_apply, restrict_restrict) <= int^-_{M cap K} ||theta||_e dH^n < infinity by V.integrableOn_mult.
(ii): (spt V)^c = U^c cup (supp mu)^c; mu((supp mu)^c) = 0 (measure_compl_support); mu(U^c) = 0 since (H^n|M)(U^c) = H^n(U^c cap M) = H^n(empty) by restrict_apply₀' and M subset U.
